title: Root Law of Root October 2025 candidate summaries (unverified)

scope_strategy.name: M0 candidate: local Marquise and Eyrie warrior Move conditions
notes: Draft paraphrases against the official 2025-10-13 Law; independent human source review is required.
M0 checks local warrior movement and Eyrie Decree Move origin-suit conditions, not full turn action availability or complete Decree progress.
Pawn movement, other factions, card effects, map exceptions, and unmodelled interactions are outside this candidate package.
Package-local IDs mirror official section references; they are not independent official identifiers.

source_content:
Candidate paraphrases for human review; not verbatim official rule text.
Official source: The Law of Root, October 13, 2025.
Locator: https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/0106/0162/7706/files/Root_Base_Law_Oct_2025.pdf?v=1774903756
2.1.1 Birds Are Wild: A bird card can represent another card suit when matching a suit is required.
2.2 Clearings and Paths: The Woodland map has clearings linked by paths.
2.2.1 Adjacency: Two clearings joined by a path are adjacent.
2.2.2 Suit: Each clearing has one of three suits: fox, rabbit, or mouse.
2.5 Rule: Compare each player’s warriors plus buildings in a clearing; an ordinary tie leaves it unruled, while tokens and pawns do not contribute.
4.2 Move: Move at least one of your own warriors and/or pawns from one clearing along a linking path to an adjacent clearing.
4.2.1 You Must Rule: Taking a Move requires rule of the origin or the destination, subject to applicable faction and card exceptions.
6.5.2 March: The Marquise Daylight March action permits up to two Moves; action availability is outside this local-condition package.
7.2.2 Lords of the Forest: On a tie for the highest warrior-plus-building total, the Eyrie rule if at least one Eyrie piece is present.
7.5.2 Resolve the Decree: During Daylight, the Eyrie resolve Decree columns in order and attempt each listed action; full Decree progress is outside M0.
7.5.2.II Move column: A Decree Move card requires moving at least one warrior from a clearing whose suit matches the card.

applies_when: A proposed local warrior Move crosses between two clearings.
acceptable_evidence: Human-reviewed source references for sections 2.2, 2.2.1, and 4.2, plus current Case path facts.
satisfied_when: A linking path makes the origin and destination adjacent in the current state.

applies_when: The proposed local warrior Move depends on piece count and clearing rule.
acceptable_evidence: Human-reviewed source references for sections 2.5, 4.2, 4.2.1, and applicable 7.2.2, plus current Case piece counts.
satisfied_when: At least one owned warrior can move and the mover rules the origin or destination under the applicable tie rule.

applies_when: The proposed local Move is an Eyrie Decree Move.
acceptable_evidence: Human-reviewed source references for sections 2.1.1, 2.2.2, 7.5.2, and 7.5.2.II, plus the current card and origin suit.
satisfied_when: The Move card is in the relevant Decree column and the origin clearing matches its suit, including a valid bird-card substitution.
